input: Research acoustic panel options for the home studio

gold.taskTitle: Research acoustic panels for home studio
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate acoustic panel options suitable for a home studio setup.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of your home studio?
questions.description: Understanding whether the studio is for recording, mixing, podcasting, music production, etc. will shape which acoustic treatment is most relevant.

questions.title: What are the dimensions of the studio room?
questions.description: Room size directly affects how many panels are needed and what thickness or density is appropriate.

questions.title: What is your total budget for acoustic panels?
questions.description: Budget determines whether to focus on DIY builds, mid-range products, or professional-grade solutions.

questions.title: Do you want to buy panels or build them yourself?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user prefers ready-made products or a DIY approach will focus the research direction significantly.

questions.title: What specific acoustic problem are you trying to solve?
questions.description: Identifying whether the issue is echo, bass buildup, flutter, or general sound leakage determines the type of treatment needed.

questions.title: Are there any visual or aesthetic requirements for the panels?
questions.description: Some users need panels that blend into decor or match a color scheme, which narrows product or fabric choices.

questions.title: Which surfaces are you planning to treat with panels?
questions.description: Whether the target is walls, ceiling, corners, or all surfaces affects the types and quantities of panels to research.
